name: Identify significant construction issues
instruction: Exclude routine administrative discussion unless it affects delivery, cost, compliance or a decision.

name: Identify contractual specification deviations
instruction: Compare stated specifications, BOQ requirements and proposed or installed materials when evidence is available.

name: Distinguish approval stages
instruction: Separate submitted, under review, approved, conditionally approved, rejected and closed.

name: Identify missing technical evidence
instruction: Detect missing calculations, certificates, drawings, material data or test results.

name: Identify engineering dependencies
instruction: Flag potential effects on connected systems, design assumptions or construction activities.

name: Identify variation-order implications
instruction: Assess whether a proposed change requires supporting design, quantity, programme or cost information.

name: Identify EOT-related issues
instruction: Extract reported delay causes, responsibility disputes, notices and missing substantiation.

name: Identify procurement and sequencing problems
instruction: Detect when procurement, installation or approval activities are out of sequence.

name: Identify commercial exposure
instruction: Flag matters that may affect payment, claims, variations or rework without inventing financial values.

name: Validate reported project progress
instruction: Check the stated measurement basis, scope and comparability of progress figures.

name: Identify recurring quality problems
instruction: Track defects, NCRs, rectification proposals and inspection closure.

name: Track decisions and commitments
instruction: Preserve committed dates, decision authority and subsequent changes.

name: Identify contradictions
instruction: Detect conflicting technical values, responsibilities, statements or reported statuses.

name: Analyse recurring issues
instruction: Link related discussions across meetings without creating unnecessary duplicate issues.

name: Determine evidence-supported status
instruction: Do not mark an issue closed solely because it disappears from subsequent minutes.

name: Generate management intelligence
instruction: Present the issue, technical implications, evidence gaps and recommended next verification step.
